Review article with no primary data. The paper asserts that NDWI can indicate crop water status and help plan irrigation to avoid excess or deficit use, but this is narrative synthesis of cited literature, not an own result on remote sensing conserving water or preventing over-irrigation; its conclusion even states more research is needed to set threshold values for practical irrigation application.
